title: Cairo, Hurghada & Sharm El Sheikh — 07 Nights
intro: Both coasts of the Red Sea in one week, with Cairo at either end. The Giza Plateau and the Grand Egyptian Museum to open; two all-inclusive nights in Hurghada with nothing on the schedule; then across the Gulf of Suez to Naama Bay for Soho Square and a full day in Ras Muhammad. Home by way of the Civilization Museum, Old Cairo and a farewell dinner with a Sufi performance.

days.title: The Pyramids of Giza & the Grand Egyptian Museum
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel, then meet your private Egyptologist guide.
The Giza Plateau: the Great Pyramid of Khufu, the pyramids of Khafre and Menkaure, and the panoramic viewpoint over all three.
The Great Sphinx and the Valley Temple of Khafre.
Lunch at a local restaurant overlooking the plateau.
The Grand Egyptian Museum — the hanging obelisk, the Ramses II atrium, the grand staircase and the complete Tutankhamun collection.
Transfer back to your hotel; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Cairo.

days.title: Cairo to Hurghada — Arrival on the Red Sea
days.description:
Breakfast at your hotel and check-out.
Fly to Hurghada — around one hour — or travel by private air-conditioned vehicle in roughly 5 hours down the coast road, with comfort stops en route.
Arrival and check-in at your Hurghada resort on an all-inclusive basis.
The rest of the day is yours: the private beach, the pools, and nothing on the schedule.
Overnight in Hurghada.
days.hotel: Jaz Aquamarine / Sunrise Holidays Resort, Hurghada (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Hurghada at Leisure
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
A full day at leisure on an all-inclusive basis — beach, pools, house reef and spa.
The water-sports desk can arrange snorkelling, a banana-boat run or an introductory dive locally, at extra cost.
Sunset from the beach, then dinner at the resort.
Overnight in Hurghada.
days.hotel: Jaz Aquamarine / Sunrise Holidays Resort, Hurghada (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Across the Gulf to Sharm El Sheikh — Soho Square & the Old Market
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort and check-out.
Transfer to Hurghada port and cross the Gulf of Suez to Sharm El Sheikh by fast ferry — the short way between the two coasts.
The ferry runs to a seasonal schedule; where it is not operating we substitute a domestic flight via Cairo at no change to the programme.
Arrival and check-in at your Naama Bay resort on an all-inclusive basis.
Evening out at Soho Square — the dancing fountain, the ice bar and the promenade — then the Old Market for spices and souvenirs.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
days.hotel: Naama Bay, Sharm El Sheikh — 4★ resort (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Ras Muhammad National Park by Boat
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort.
A full-day boat trip into Ras Muhammad National Park, at the southern tip of Sinai where the two gulfs of the Red Sea meet.
Two swim stops over the Shark and Yolanda reefs — the clearest water and the richest coral wall in Sinai — with equipment provided.
Lunch served on board, with time on deck between stops.
Back to the resort in the late afternoon; evening at leisure.
Overnight in Sharm El Sheikh.
days.hotel: Naama Bay, Sharm El Sheikh — 4★ resort (or similar), all-inclusive

days.title: Back to Cairo — Egyptian Civilization, Old Cairo & a Farewell Dinner
days.description:
Breakfast at your resort and check-out.
Morning flight from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo — around one hour — and transfer straight into the day with your private Egyptologist.
The National Museum of Egyptian Civilization in Fustat: the Royal Mummies Hall and five thousand years of Egypt in one gallery.
Lunch at a local restaurant.
Old Cairo on foot — the Hanging Church, St Sergius and the Ben Ezra Synagogue — then Al-Moez Ldin Allah Street through medieval Cairo to Khan El-Khalili.
Farewell dinner at Mamai with a live oriental show and a Sufi tanoura performance.
Check-in and overnight in Cairo.

arrival.title: Arrival in Cairo — Welcome Dinner
arrival.description:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport.
Meet & assist by our representative through visa, passport and customs formalities.
Private air-conditioned transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Check-in and time to freshen up after your journey.
Welcome dinner with your host — a first taste of Egyptian cooking and a walk-through of the days ahead.
Overnight in Cairo.

departure.title: Departure
departure.description:
Breakfast at your hotel (subject to flight timing).
Check-out and assistance with your luggage.
Private air-conditioned transfer to Cairo International Airport.
Final meet & assist through departure formalities — we wish you a safe journey home.
